description: Postgame event triggers and special encounters after becoming Champion.

events.name: Cerulean Cave Unlocked
events.description: The guard blocking Cerulean Cave steps aside.

events.name: Mewtwo Encounter
events.description: Mewtwo awaits at the deepest floor of Cerulean Cave.

events.name: Legendary Birds Available
events.description: Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres can now be found.

events.name: Gym Leader Rematches
events.description: Gym Leaders are available for stronger rematches.

events.name: Rival Rematch at Indigo Plateau
events.description: Your rival trains at the Indigo Plateau for rematches.

events.name: Battle Tower Opens
events.description: The Battle Tower is now accessible.

events.name: Oak's Evaluation
events.description: Professor Oak evaluates your Pokedex completion.

events.name: Elite Four Rematch
events.description: The Elite Four has stronger teams for rematches.

events.name: Safari Zone Expansion
events.description: New areas in the Safari Zone are now accessible.

events.name: Mew Event
events.description: A mysterious Pokemon appears after completing the Pokedex.
